subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises and uses prefixes (un-, re-) and suffixes (-ful, -ness)

show.line: Add un to happy. Unhappy! Add ful to care. Careful! Little word parts change the meaning.

rounds.prompt: Add un to the word tidy. Which word do you get?
Re means again. Which word means write again?
Add ful to help. Say the new word.
Add ness to sad. Which word do you get?
Starts with un or re, or ends with ful or ness? Sort the words.

rounds.text: The careful boy was never unkind.
accept: the careful boy was never unkind

hints: un means not. re means again.
ful means full of. ness turns a describing word into a thing.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will add un to lucky.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Un goes at the front. Unlucky.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. Un, lucky. Unlucky!

parent_line: Can build words with un, re, ful and ness.
